record.original_question: Let F be any discontinuous group of Möbius transformations of D. Does there always exist a meromorphic function automorphic with respect to Γ and normal, i. e. such that |f ′ (z)| (1 − |z|2 ) 1 + |f (z)|2 is bounded in D? (Ch. Pommerenke)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disc. A meromorphic function $f$ on $\mathbb{D}$ is called normal if
$$\sup_{z\in\mathbb{D}}\frac{|f'(z)|(1-|z|^2)}{1+|f(z)|^2}<\infty,$$
where the spherical derivative is interpreted in the usual way at the poles of $f$. A group $\Gamma$ of Möbius transformations of $\mathbb{D}$ onto itself is called discontinuous if it acts properly discontinuously on $\mathbb{D}$. A meromorphic function $f$ on $\mathbb{D}$ is automorphic with respect to $\Gamma$ if $f\circ\gamma = f$ for every $\gamma\in\Gamma$.

Question: Does every discontinuous group $\Gamma$ of Möbius transformations of $\mathbb{D}$ admit a non-constant meromorphic function on $\mathbb{D}$ that is automorphic with respect to $\Gamma$ and normal?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface related work by Pommerenke and collaborators on Bloch and normal functions, and on automorphic/polymorphic functions for Fuchsian groups, but no source consulted definitively settles whether every discontinuous Möbius group of the disc admits a non-constant normal automorphic meromorphic function. The status appears unresolved in the sources found.

status_evidence.title: On Bloch functions and normal functions
status_evidence.snippet: Anderson, Clunie, Pommerenke study normal/Bloch functions; the work concerns the boundedness of the spherical derivative weighted by (1-|z|^2).
status_evidence.claim: Background on normal functions defined via the bounded spherical derivative condition relevant to the problem.

status_evidence.title: On groups and normal polymorphic functions
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses normal automorphic/polymorphic functions for discontinuous groups acting on the disc.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates ongoing research on normality conditions for automorphic functions associated with discontinuous groups, but does not confirm a complete resolution of Pommerenke's question.
